whoItsFor: Researchers and ML engineers with an already-runnable project that has a measurable objective and an unknown best path forward, who want an autonomous system to run the iterative research loop.
useCases: Optimize a measurable metric in an existing runnable research project across multiple generations
Run parallel research peers that explore competing hypotheses and implementations concurrently
Produce auditable negative-result evidence packages when a research direction does not improve

requirements.os: Linux (continuously release-tested); macOS and other CPython 3.11+ environments are a compatibility target

installCommand: python3 -m pip install --index-url https://pypi.org/simple "praxist[agents,codex]" && praxist setup --interactive --install-skills codex
